battle.name: 波斯灣戰爭
battle.brief: 1990年8月伊拉克出兵科威特，波斯灣戰爭隨之展開。多國聯軍在空中與地面作戰中投入已列裝的M1A1主力戰車，以120毫米主砲支援裝甲突擊，突破對方陣地並掩護步兵推進。

kit.name: M1A1主力戰車
kit.history: 1985年列裝的美軍主力戰車，1991年地面作戰期間配屬聯軍裝甲部隊，用於前線突擊與對抗對方戰車。

countries: 1990年8月2日伊拉克總統薩達姆·侯賽因下令入侵科威特，標誌著波斯灣危機的開始。隨後，聯合國安全理事會迅速通過多項決議，要求伊拉克無條件撤軍。以美國為首的聯軍迅速組建，成员包括英國、法國、沙特阿拉伯、埃及、敘利亞、加拿大、澳洲等三十多個國家。美國派遣了約540,000名官兵，英國派出了45,000名士兵，法國提供約15,000人，沙特阿拉伯則投入約60,000名士兵和大量後勤支援。科威特流亡政府於利雅得設立臨時機構，协同聯軍作戰。伊拉克則動員約650,000名正規軍及數萬名共和国衞隊，部署在科威特及伊拉克南部的防守線上。整體而言，聯軍在兵力規模、空中優勢與技術裝備上皆具壓倒性優勢。
countriesEn: On 2 August 1990, Iraqi President Saddam Hussein ordered the invasion of Kuwait, marking the start of the Persian Gulf crisis. The United Nations Security Council quickly passed multiple resolutions demanding the unconditional withdrawal of Iraqi forces. A U.S.-led coalition was rapidly assembled, comprising more than thirty nations including the United Kingdom, France, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Syria, Canada, Australia, and others. The United States deployed approximately 540,000 troops, the United Kingdom about 45,000, France roughly 15,000, and Saudi Arabia contributed around 60,000 soldiers together with extensive logistics support. The Kuwaiti government‑in‑exile established a provisional administration in Riyadh, coordinating with the coalition. Iraq mobilized roughly 650,000 regular soldiers and tens of thousands of Republican Guard troops, positioning them along the Kuwait‑Iraq border and in southern Iraq. Overall, the coalition possessed overwhelming advantages in manpower, air superiority, and technological equipment.
people: 在聯軍方面，指揮中樞由美國中央司令部司令諾曼·施瓦茨科普夫上將（General Norman Schwarzkopf）擔任，他制定並執行“沙漠風暴”行動的整體戰略。副司令為美軍參謀長聯席會議主席鮑威爾上將（General Colin Powell），負責政治與軍事協調。英國派遣了第1裝甲師師長湯姆森准將（Brigadier Tony Thompson），率領“沙漠之鼠”裝甲兵團參與左鉤戰術。法國的空軍則由第4航空軍司令讓-皮埃爾·凱勒中將（Général Jean-Pierre Kelche）指揮，提供幻象F1與美洲獅攻擊機的空中支援。伊拉克軍隊的關鍵人物包括薩達姆·侯賽因的軍事顧問阿里·哈桑·馬吉德（Ali Hassan al-Majid），以及負責防線的第3軍團司令阿布德·卡里姆·卡希姆·穆罕默德·阿布·貝克爾（Abdul Karim Qasim）。雙方的情報單位在電子戰與間諜行動上展開激烈較量，尤其依賴美國的衛星情報與英國的信號情報船隻。
peopleEn: In the coalition, command authority rested with U.S. Central Command commander General Norman Schwarzkopf, who devised and oversaw the overall strategy of Operation Desert Storm. His deputy was Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff General Colin Powell, handling political‑military coordination. The United Kingdom sent Brigadier Tony Thompson, commander of the 1st Armoured Division, to lead the “Desert Rats” armored brigade in the left‑hook maneuver. France’s air force was directed by Lieutenant General Jean‑Pierre Kelche, commanding the 4th Air Force and providing Mirage F1 and Mirage 2000 attack aircraft for air support. Key Iraqi figures included Saddam Hussein’s military advisor Ali Hassan al‑Majid and the commander of the III Corps, General Abdul Karim Qasim, who oversaw defensive lines. Both sides conducted intense electronic warfare and espionage, with the United States relying heavily on satellite intelligence and the United Kingdom deploying signals‑intelligence vessels.
kits: 聯軍在空中動用了大量當時已服役的先進機型，包括美國的F-15C/D“鹰”式與F-15E“攻擊鹰”戰鬥機，主要執行制空權爭奪與精確轟炸任務；F-16A/B“戰鬥隼”與F-16C/D執行對地攻擊，配備GBU-15、GBU-24激光制導炸彈；F-111F“土豚”變後掠翼轟炸機以低空高速突破伊拉克防空網；A-10“雷霆II”攻擊機則專門用於近距離支援，掛載AGM-65“小牛”導彈與30mm機炮。海軍方面，美國海軍航空母艦USS Midway、Ranger、Nimitz等艦載F/A-18“大黃蜂”與F-14“雄貓”為主力。陸軍裝甲主力為M1A1“艾布拉姆斯”與M1“艾布拉姆斯”坦克，搭乘M2A2“布拉德利”步兵戰車；英國的“挑戰者1”與德國的“豹1”坦克亦投入戰場。炮兵使用M109A2自行榴彈炮與M110 203mm自走炮，提供遠程火力支援。伊拉克軍隊主要裝備T-72、T-62坦克，BMP-1/2步兵戰車，以及舊式RPG-7與喀秋莎火箭筒；防空系統則包括ZSU-23-4自行高炮與SA-7、SA-14便攜式防空導彈，但在聯軍電子戰與精確打擊下損失慘重。
kitsEn: The coalition employed a large number of then‑operational advanced aircraft. The U.S. fielded F‑15C/D Eagle and F‑15E Strike Eagle fighters for air‑ superiority and precision bombing; F‑16A/B and F‑16C/D Fighting Falcons performed ground‑attack missions, carrying GBU‑15 and GBU‑24 laser‑guided bombs. The variable‑sweep‑wing F‑111F Aardvark penetrated Iraqi air defenses at low altitude and high speed, while the A‑10 Thunderbolt II was dedicated to close‑support, armed with AGM‑65 Maverick missiles and a 30 mm cannon. At sea, U.S. Navy carriers USS Midway, Ranger, and Nimitz deployed F/A‑18 Hornet and F‑14 Tomcat aircraft. On the ground, the main armored forces were the M1A1 Abrams and M1 Abrams tanks, supported by M2A2 Bradley infantry fighting vehicles; British Challenger 1 and German Leopard 1 tanks also entered the battle. Artillery included the M109A2 self‑propelled howitzer and the M110 203 mm self‑propelled gun for long‑range fire support. Iraqi forces were equipped chiefly with T‑72 and T‑62 tanks, BMP‑1/2 infantry fighting vehicles, older RPG‑7 rockets and Katyusha launchers; air‑defense assets comprised ZSU‑23‑4 self‑propelled anti‑aircraft guns and SA‑7/SA‑14 portable missiles, but suffered heavy losses under coalition electronic warfare and precision strikes.
tactics: “沙漠風暴”行動的戰術分為三個階段：空中打擊、地面進攻與後續掃蕩。空中打擊階段從1991年1月17日開始，聯軍以“先發制人”方式，使用隱形戰鬥機F-117A突入巴格達市中心，摧毀指揮與控制節點；隨後F-15、F-16、F/A-18等戰機以“防空壓制”（SEAD）任務，發射AGM-88“哈姆”導彈與AGM-65“小牛”，削弱伊拉克雷達與防空火力。電子戰手段包括EA-6B“徘徊者”電子干擾機與EC-130H“羅盤呼叫”，干擾伊拉克通信與雷達訊號。地面階段於1991年2月24日啟動，代号为“左鉤”的第七軍團與第十八空降軍在海灣海岸線向科威特內陸突破，英國第1裝甲師從西側繞過伊拉克防線，實施分割包圍；同時，美軍第1步兵師與第1裝甲師在科威特市區外圍展開突擊，迫使伊拉克共和國衞隊撤退。整體作战以“集中火力、快速機動”為原則，結合精確制導武器與空中支援，形成壓倒性火力優勢。
tacticsEn: Operation Desert Storm was executed in three phases: air campaign, ground offensive, and subsequent clearance. The air campaign began on 17 January 1991, when the coalition launched a preemptive strike using F‑117A Nighthawk stealth fighters to penetrate downtown Baghdad and destroy command‑and‑control nodes; subsequently, F‑15, F‑16, and F/A‑18 aircraft performed suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), firing AGM‑88 HARM missiles and AGM‑65 Mavericks to weaken Iraqi radar and air‑defence fire. Electronic‑warfare assets such as EA‑6B Prowlers and EC‑130H Compass Call jammed Iraqi communications and radar. The ground phase began on 24 February 1991 with the “left hook”: VII Corps and XVIII Airborne Corps broke through the Kuwaiti coast line toward the interior, while the British 1st Armoured Division bypassed Iraqi positions from the west, encircling the enemy. Simultaneously, the U.S. 1st Infantry Division and 1st Armored Division assaulted the outskirts of Kuwait City, forcing the Republican Guard to retreat. The overall doctrine emphasized concentrated firepower and rapid maneuver, integrating precision‑guided weapons with continuous air support to create overwhelming fire superiority.
data: 1990年8月2日伊拉克入侵科威特，當天科威特城陷落。1990年11月29日，聯合國安理會通過第678號決議，授權會員國使用一切必要手段將伊拉克逐出科威特。1991年1月17日凌晨0時40分，聯軍發動第一波空襲，代號“沙漠風暴”。空軍共出動約10萬架次戰機，投放超過8.8萬噸彈藥。地面進攻於2月24日凌晨4時正式開始，聯軍兵力包括美軍第1、3、4、5、6、7、24、25步兵師及第1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8裝甲師，英國第1裝甲師，法國第6輕裝甲師等，總兵力超過660,000人。伊拉克軍隊在科威特境內部署約540,000名正規軍及共和國衞隊，坦克約3,500輛，裝甲車約2,400輛，火炮約3,000門。2月26日，聯軍攻佔科威特市，2月28日午夜正式停火。整場戰鬥持續約100小時，地面作戰僅42小時。
dataEn: On 2 August 1990 Iraq invaded Kuwait and the city fell the same day. On 29 November 1990 the UN Security Council adopted Resolution 678, authorizing member states to use all necessary means to expel Iraqi forces. At 00:40 on 17 January 1991 the coalition launched the first wave of air strikes, code‑named Operation Desert Storm. The air force flew roughly 100,000 sorties and delivered more than 88,000 tons of munitions. The ground offensive began at 04:00 on 24 February 1991, with coalition forces comprising the U.S. 1st, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, 24th, and 25th Infantry Divisions, the 1st through 8th Armored Divisions, the British 1st Armoured Division, the French 6th Light Armored Division, and others—totalling over 660,000 troops. Iraqi forces in Kuwait comprised roughly 540,000 regular soldiers and Republican Guard troops, about 3,500 tanks, 2,400 armored vehicles, and 3,000 artillery pieces. On 26 February the coalition captured Kuwait City, and a ceasefire took effect at midnight on 28 February. The entire conflict lasted about 100 hours, with only 42 hours of ground combat.
cause: 1990年8月1日，伊拉克總統薩達姆·侯賽因在一次演說中指責科威特超額開採與違反OPEC配額，導致全球油價下跌，並聲稱科威特在兩伊戰爭期間向伊拉克提供了“地下”借貸，要求免除或大幅減免高達140億美元的債務。8月2日拂曉，伊拉克軍隊以第3軍團與共和國衞隊共約10萬人分三路越境，快速佔領科威特全境，並宣布科威特為伊拉克的第19個省。此舉激怒了海灣合作委員會及西方國家，特別是美國在海灣的石油利益與地區安全戰略受到直接威脅，促使美國迅速組織多國聯盟，以維護國際法與地區穩定。
causeEn: On 1 August 1990 Iraqi President Saddam Hussein accused Kuwait of overproducing oil and violating OPEC quotas in a speech, asserting that this caused a global oil price decline, and claimed that Kuwait had provided Iraq with “under‑the‑table” loans during the Iran‑Iraq War, demanding the forgiveness or substantial reduction of up to $14 billion in debts. At dawn on 2 August the Iraqi army, employing the III Corps and Republican Guard units totalling roughly 100,000 men in three columns, crossed the border and swiftly occupied all of Kuwait, declaring it the 19th province of Iraq. This act enraged the Gulf Cooperation Council and Western nations; the United States, whose oil interests and regional security strategy in the Gulf were directly threatened, moved quickly to organize a multinational coalition to uphold international law and regional stability.
impact: 波斯灣戰爭結束後，伊拉克被迫從科威特撤軍，並在1991年4月的停火協議中接受聯合國武器核查機制。戰爭結果使美國在海灣地區的軍事存在大幅提升，沙特阿拉伯、科威特等國允許美軍設立永久或長期基地，以確保地區安全。經濟上，油價在戰爭初期飆升後迅速回落，促進了全球能源市場的穩定。政治上，伊拉克的軍事力量受重創，但其仍然保留部分生化武器與飛彈計畫，成為後續制裁與核查的焦點。以色列在戰爭期間遭受伊拉克飛毛腿導彈襲擊，迫使其中央政府加強防空與防禦體系。整體而言，戰爭重塑了中東的權力格局，促成了美國與其盟友的軍事合作機制，並為1990年代末的“海灣戰爭”留下了深遠的戰略影響。
impactEn: After the Persian Gulf War, Iraq was forced to withdraw from Kuwait and, in the April 1991 ceasefire agreement, accepted the United Nations weapons‑inspection regime. The war resulted in a substantial increase of the U.S. military presence in the Gulf; Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and other nations granted the United States permanent or long‑term bases to ensure regional security. Economically, oil prices surged at the outbreak of the war but quickly receded, fostering stability in the global energy market. Politically, Iraq’s military capacity was severely damaged, yet it retained parts of its chemical and missile programmes, becoming the focus of subsequent sanctions and inspections. During the conflict Israel was targeted by Iraqi Scud missiles, prompting the Israeli government to bolster its air‑defence and defensive capabilities. Overall, the war reshaped the power balance in the Middle East, solidified U.S.‑led military cooperation with allies, and left a lasting strategic legacy for the late‑1990s Gulf region.
result: 1991年2月28日午夜，伊拉克接受聯合國第687號停火決議，宣佈單方面停火並承諾從科威特撤軍。3月3日，雙方在沙特阿拉伯的哈夫阿爾-錫德舉行會談，正式確認撤軍時間表。3月10日，最後一批伊拉克軍隊撤出科威特，隨後科威特流亡政府返回首都。聯軍在戰爭中宣稱摧毀或俘獲伊拉克坦克約3,500輛、裝甲車約2,400輛、火炮約1,400門，並癱瘓其主要煉油與發電設施。美國在戰後維持對伊拉克的制裁與武器核查，並於1992年在伊拉克北部設立禁航區。此役標誌著美軍資訊化、精確打擊與聯合作戰的成熟，奠定了其後在巴爾幹、阿富汗及伊拉克的軍事行動模式。
resultEn: At midnight on 28 February 1991 Iraq accepted UN Security Council Resolution 687, declaring a unilateral ceasefire and pledging to withdraw from Kuwait. On 3 March the two sides met in Hafir al‑Shaykh, Saudi Arabia, to formalize the withdrawal timetable. By 10 March the last Iraqi units had left Kuwait, and the Kuwaiti government‑in‑exile returned to the capital. The coalition claimed the destruction or capture of roughly 3,500 Iraqi tanks, 2,400 armored vehicles, and 1,400 artillery pieces, and crippled Iraq’s major refining and power‑generation facilities. The United States maintained sanctions and weapons inspections after the war and, in 1992, imposed a no‑fly zone over northern Iraq. The conflict marked the maturation of U.S. information‑centric warfare, precision strike capabilities, and joint operations, laying the groundwork for subsequent military campaigns in the Balkans, Afghanistan, and the later Iraq war.
